target.description: Title or caption visible in 0-3s with at most six words

creator.policy: Unavailable applicable measurements score zero; explicitly speech-free groups are excluded and weights renormalized. Delivery is a separate gate.

evidence.speech: Whisper full token timestamps on FINAL audio; token join and filler context are estimates
evidence.captions: Engine editorial caption ids; conservative font envelopes; skin/centre subject heuristic at 1 fps. Not face-detector certification.
evidence.colour: CIEDE2000 on per-clip sampled midtone RGB means; full-frame full-range luma clipping.
evidence.duck: Estimated from saved music/background-audio volume and duck-gain envelopes; source dynamics are unknown. Unavailable if no bed or speech/gap windows exist.
evidence.frame: 108x192 grey affine-photometric MAD +/-3 source frames (best/second cost ratio <=0.9 and absolute separation >=0.02) with float perspective alignment; no integer crop approximation. EDL cuts are excluded. Text envelopes are masked on both source and output; unknown animated geometry is unmeasured. Expected indices use the global grid, source rate and speed, clamped to exact ffprobe nb_frames when available. Intended EOF/rate-conversion/slow-motion holds are not judder. Animated mappings and ambiguous static frames reduce coverage.
evidence.camera: Source-referenced small-translation least squares with affine brightness fit on 108x192 decoded grey frames; masked overlay envelopes and gradient neighbours. SG7 high-frequency residual normalized to 1080 short side. Flat/aperture/poor fits are unavailable; requires 95% eligible coverage. Physical source motion cancels against the same expected source frame. This estimate does not certify source-frame identity. The old whole-picture measure remains content_motion_jitter_px. Compare measurement version4 before and after only. Version4 corrects only the aggregate frame denominator from the original saved registration counts; the original version3 file is retained separately.
evidence.delivery: Format qualityChecks (excluding whole-content motion) plus ffprobe codec, BT.709 and audio bitrate; trace_headers verifies IDR keyframes and ffprobe timestamps verify CFR. Motion retains its separate source-referenced gates.

correction.method: Saved adjacent-pair comparison counts reconstruct total output frames (+1); reaggregate unchanged SG7 registration counts with a frame denominator. No decoding, new fits, threshold relaxation or image changes.
